title: National Land Transport Act Amendment (Better Value for Taxpayers) Bill 2025
short_title: National Land Transport Act Amendment (Better Value for Taxpayers) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require the Federal Government to publish more information about how it chooses and manages large land transport projects.
It would mandate a long-term national transport plan, public release of business cases for large projects, and published reviews of completed projects.
The government has committed $120 billion to infrastructure over ten years, but reviews found $32 billion in cost pressures and a lack of transparency in project selection.
changes: The bill would require the government to create and release a periodic national land transport plan that details priorities and investment assumptions.
It would make all business cases for federally funded projects above an unspecified threshold publicly available.
It would require the government to carry out and publish post-completion reviews for projects over a certain cost and time threshold.
summary.affected: The Federal Government and taxpayers are affected by the bill.
